differences.what: The camera is not fitted: no dimension of the 1870 wings was found, so the pictures cannot be scaled against each other and the model is set by eye
The wings are a storey short of the photograph's and lack its attic of round windows under the scrolled crests and the urns along the parapet
The great cupola stands lower and narrower than in the photograph, and its clock stage is missing
Tones: the 1853 house dark and the wings pale, as the photograph shows them
The trees, fence and wagons of the square

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
